units.source_text: 科林斯式风格的柱子，哥特式风格的穹隆，阿拉伯风格的方格花纹，分离派的祈祷桌子——

en.t: Corinthian-style pillars, Gothic-style vaults, Arabian-style lattice patterns, and Secessionist prayer desks—

units.source_text: 这些东西和谐的调和在一起，竟然有一种神奇的野性粗狂的美。

en.t: All these things blended together harmoniously, and somehow they had a strange, wild, rough beauty.

units.source_text: 两侧神龛里的大理石半身像尤其吸引我的目光。

en.t: The marble busts in the niches on both sides especially drew my eye.

units.source_text: 我对这些像似曾相似，这倒也不算神奇。

en.t: I felt as though I had seen those statues before, which was not particularly strange.

units.source_text: 那只弯腰驼背的老河童结束了“生命之树”的介绍后，陪着我和拉卟一起走向右边的神龛，

en.t: After the bent-backed old kappa finished his explanation of the Tree of Life, he accompanied Lap and me toward the niche on the right,

units.source_text: 他这样描述神龛里的半身像：“这是我们其中一个圣徒——背叛一切的圣徒斯特林堡。

en.t: and described the bust inside the niche like this: "This is one of our saints, the saint Strindberg, who betrayed everything.

units.source_text: 据说这位圣徒历尽艰苦后被斯维登堡的哲学所解救。

en.t: It is said that after enduring every hardship, this saint was saved by Swedenborg's philosophy.

units.source_text: 不过事实上他并没有得到解救。

en.t: But in fact, he was not saved at all.

units.source_text: 这位圣徒也和我们一样信仰生活教——准确来说，他只有信仰生活教这一条出路。

en.t: This saint, like us, also believed in the Religion of Life; more precisely, believing in the Religion of Life was his only way out.

units.source_text: 请读一下这位圣徒给我们留下的《传说》这本书。

en.t: Please read the book Legends, which this saint left to us.

units.source_text: 他自己承认，他是个自杀未遂者。”

en.t: He himself admits that he was a failed suicide."
